name: Eye-trace bridge analysis
summary: Compare the focal position at the end of one shot and the start of the next to choose a transition that respects where the eye already is.
creativeJobs: decide whether a cut needs help at all
mediaPrerequisites: a focal estimate for the outgoing and incoming frames
qualityChecks: focal estimate matches where a viewer actually looks
the recommendation changes when the focal points are near versus far apart
failureModes: treating a saliency estimate as ground truth about attention
recommending a transition where a plain cut is stronger

riskGates.basis: Reference-only analysis cannot alter the edit.

provenance.claim: Final Cut provides transitions intended to smooth otherwise jarring cuts

validation.notes: Requires focal analysis FrameSmith does not have. Listed because it is the analysis that should PRECEDE offering a transition, and offering transitions without it is guessing.

refusalConditions: Do not apply when the stated prerequisite is not met.
safety: Review the result on representative media before use.
